additional_info.subject: RE: ID0407175-DC/Si-D/AE-[MP / R8 170002423] Charger stuck at Hello Screen CRM:01410001481
additional_info.body:
Hi Basheer,
Good Morning,
Could you please confirm if the intervention can be postponed to Tuesday (18th March) or Wednesday (19th March), depending on your availability? The reason for this is that we have only one resource available during that time. If it’s fixed for Monday (17th March), please let us know as well.
Please find the configuration file of the charger attached. Below are the steps that need to be performed related to flashing the CFAST card and restoring the configuration. I hope you already having the Live Linux user scripts with you, if not please let us know we will share it via Secufex or OneDrive.
Download and extraction of firmware from SCB
Download and extraction of Live Linux image
Download of SW tools required
Flashing of Live Linux image on 32GB USB stick
Flashing of firmware on CFast card
Please download the current FW image from SCB, You can find the firmware here:
https://configuration.sicharge.technology/firmware-images/list
Here's the setup required for the intervention:
HW Devices:
Laptop With Admin Rights.
Should be able to access dual network (Both ethernet/Wifi)
2 Ethernet cables
1 or 2 USB drivers 32 GB.
CFast Card Reader
Electric ties
SW Tools:
MobaXterm
HDD Raw Copy Tool Portable
Bunzip2
Rufus
Companion tool
7 Zip
Software:
Live Linux user scripts
Config file of the charger (already shared on the email)
Preparation:
Download of the firmware image from SCB
Flashing of FW image on Cfast card via Rufus or Flashing FW image on CFast card via Companion tool
Extraction of Live Linux Image via 7zip (depends on laptop performance)
Flashing of Live Linux image on USB driver(make sure to create the Data folder in the root if the USB)
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shrey
